name: 6 Wunderkinder GmbH
description: Microsoft acquired 6Wunderkinder, the creator of the to-do list app Wunderlist, in June 2015 to be included in their broader portfolio. Wunderlist fits squarely with Microsoft's ambition to reinvent productivity for a mobile-first, cloud-first world. Building on momentum for Microsoft Office, OneNote and Skype for Business, this acquisition further demonstrates Microsoft’s commitment to delivering market leading mobile apps across the platforms and devices our customers use – for mail, calendaring, messaging, notes and now tasks.

name: abaXX Technology AG
description: abaXX Technology AG is a company specializing in providing technology solutions, particularly in areas like digital platforms, IT infrastructure, and business automation

name: Aiven

Aiven's mission is to enable developers to focus on their core business and build great applications without worrying about software infrastructure through providing integrated solutions that will allow teams to build what they couldn't imagine before.

name: Aleph Alpha
description: Based in Heidelberg, Aleph Alpha is an AI Research & Deployment company that researches, develops and operationalizes large generalizable artificial intelligence models for text, vision, and strategy to ensure the digital sovereignty for public and private sector partners.

name: Alesi Surgical
description:
Alesi Surgical is a leading innovator in the field of surgical technologies. The company has developed UltravisionTM, the world’s first system that eliminates smoke and steam during surgery without the need for gas exchange or suction devices.  Ultravision produces a low-energy electrostatic charge that can significantly improve visibility for surgeons by actively eliminating surgical smoke generated by energy-based surgical cutting instruments. The system is 23x more effective than current gas exchange systems.
In addition to improved visibility, Ultravision also allows reducing surgery time by 17%. Minimizing healthcare professionals’ exposure to surgical smoke is increasingly important worldwide because of health concerns over the risk of long-term exposure. The technology also benefits the patient as it minimizes the amount of cold, dry carbon dioxide gas used during surgery. Excessive use of carbon dioxide leads to cardiovascular problems, complications in anesthesia, post-surgical pain and longer recovery time for the patient.

name: Arago
description: Arago has built an energy-efficient AI chip powered by light, codenamed JEF, designed to run AI workloads with 10x to 30x lower energy and cost overhead. Its mission is to drive the course of history forward. Based in France, North America, and Israel, Arago has assembled a world-class team of engineers, scientists, and operators from leading companies and research labs, and is backed by executives from Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Hugging Face, as well as prominent DeepTech venture firms and exited founders.
founders: Nicolas Muller-Vorburger                                                                                                                                        Eliott Sarrey                                                                                                                                                                     Ambroise Müller

name: Arago Inc.
description: Arago develops a computing system that uses photonic technology to accelerate core operations in Artificial Intelligence and scientific computing. The company focuses on enhancing matrix multiplication performance, a key computational component in modern AI models, by using light-based processes rather than traditional electronic circuits. Its system integrates a PyTorch-based software stack with a multi-physics processor that handles tasks with cubic complexity, while a digital processor manages remaining operations with quadratic complexity. Atrial fibrillation patients have a 5x greater risk of having a stroke and 3x the risk of developing heart failure.

name: Argá Medtech SA
description: Argá Medtech is a medical device company that specializes in the manufacturing of innovative cardiac ablation systems for the treatment of cardiac arrhythmias.

Founded in Stockholm, Sweden, Aris integrates edge systems, knowledge graphs, and multi-agent AI to help industries design, industrialize, and operate with unprecedented traceability and speed.

name: Avrea

The platform includes lightning-fast CI/CD runners, deep pipeline observability, and AI-powered features that improve build reliability and test quality. Migration is a one-line change in your workflow.

description: Axon Vascular Europe is a medical device company focused on developing a novel, minimally invasive, and implant-free therapy to treat heart failure. This procedure consists of ablating one of the two greater splanchnic nerves in the body to reduce the displacement of blood from the peripheral circulation to the central circulation.

name: B2X
description:
B2X is the provider of customer care solutions for electronic devices to manufacturers, insurance providers, mobile network operators, and retailers globally.

B2X has created the first shared services platform for unparalleled customer care solutions. Their Smart Service Platform consists of a global organization of highly experienced staff, a trusted and reliable operational fulfillment partner network, and best practice service delivery processes. An end-to-end technology platform ensures consistency and quality across your service operations.

They manage backend repairs, parts, and logist

name: B2X GmbH
description: B2X is the leading global provider of end-to-end customer care solutions for mobile and IoT devices. Founded in 2007, B2X helps many of the world’s leading mobile and consumer IoT companies deliver a superior after-sales service experience. The company’s unique positioning is based on its global service partner network and its SMARTCARE Technology platform that connects everything to a digitally integrated customer care ecosystem. With more than 1,000 employees and over 500 trusted partners in 140 countries worldwide, B2X is the premier after-sales service provider for manufacturers, insurance providers, carriers and retailers.
founders: Jan Strnad, Ivo Knejp, Martin Vitous, Pavel Vašek.

name: Bayshore
description:
Bayshore was built on the conviction that legal rules should be the infrastructure of progress, not its bottleneck.

We enable legal and compliance functions in highly regulated enterprises to execute at the speed of business without losing control over risk. For multiple Global 2000 companies, we are teaching AI agents to run complex legal and compliance processes and collaborate with human experts where necessary.

By translating legal rules into code, we are shifting the paradigm. AI agents work with the determinism of legal rules instead of relying solely on the probabilistic nature of LLMs. This makes them accurate, explainable, and auditable.

name: BigChainDB
description: BigchainDB allows developers and enterprises to deploy blockchain proof-of-concepts, platforms and applications with a scalable blockchain database. Rather than trying to scale up blockchain technology, BigchainDB starts with a distributed database and then adds blockchain characteristics — decentralized control, immutability and the ability to create and transfer assets. BigchainDB supports a wide range of industries and use cases, from identity and intellectual property to supply chains, energy, IoT and financial ecosystems. With high throughput, sub-second latency and powerful functionalities for automating business processes, BigchainDB looks, acts and feels like a database, but has the core blockchain characteristics that enterprises want.

name: Black Forest Labs
description: Black Forest Labs is a pioneering developer of frontier AI for pixels, transforming how we shape and experience the visual world. An independent lab with global impact, Black Forest Labs’ technology enables creators, developers, and enterprises to make imagination reality. The Black Forest Labs team pioneered latent diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX —milestones that transformed generative AI, and made visual AI accessible to millions.

name: Brandback
description: Brandback embeds resale to improve conversion rates, customer LTV, and return rates. By integrating into online retailers' baskets, listings, and checkouts, Brandback makes resale scalable and profitable. Their resale product was launched in Q4-2024 and is used in ten countries.
founders: Chris Kilin                                                                                                                                                                                                              Wlad Peljuchno                                                                                                                                                                                                      Jan Monko                                                                                                                                                                                                             Alex Linewitsch

name: BridgeCo
description: BridgeCo creates smart, seamless networked audio solutions, enabling wireless music streaming for homes and businesses.

name: Briefcase
description:
Briefcase is creating a platform that automates the most tedious and time-consuming aspects of accounting, from bookkeeping to month-end close, using technologies like multimodal AI, agentic workflows and latest legislation embeddings. 

Building the world's first AI autopilot for accounting firms, Briefcase will redefine the way accounting is done by delivering end-to-end automation of manual bookkeeping and accounting workflows.

name: Carpooling.com
description: Carpooling.de was acquired by FlixBus in 2019, combining forces with the well-known European long-distance bus service to enhance their mobility offering, which also includes trains, buses, and now carpooling for a more sustainable, flexible, and comprehensive transportation solution.

description: Carto is a platform that turns spatial data into an efficient delivery route, better behavioral marketing, and strategic store placements. CARTO is the platform that turns spatial data into more efficient delivery routes, better behavioral marketing, strategic store placements, and much more. Data Scientists, Developers, and Analysts solve spatial problems using CARTO’s data and analysis to understand where and why things happen, optimize business processes, and predict future outcomes t

description: CARTO leads the world in location intelligence, empowering organizations and individuals to discover and predict key insights using location data. With CARTO’s intuitive location intelligence platform, analysts and developers build self-service location-based apps that help optimize operational performance, strategic investments and everyday decisions.

name: Ceartas DMCA
description:
The world's most advanced copyright protection service for content creators!

With Ceartas DMCA, you can easily monitor your content and manage your rights-lines. Our proprietary technology keeps you safe from copyright infringement, protecting you and the value of your creations with lightning-quick takedowns at a price to suit every need.

name: Ceartas DMCA Ltd
description:
The world’s top creators, agencies, and brands rely on Ceartas DMCA to prevent the unauthorized use of their creative work.
Our AI-driven system scans millions of websites to protect your intellectual property, maintaining the integrity and security of your brand. With Ceartas DMCA, you can easily monitor your content and manage your rights lines. Our proprietary technology keeps you safe from copyright infringement, protecting you and the value of your creations with lightning-quick takedowns at a price to suit every need.

Combining advanced AI with human expertise, Midnight Labs predicts, prevents, and eliminates threats to your brand. Meet Nova, your always-on AI assistant that enables you to chat, generate detailed reports, and access critical data on copyright violations, trademark infringements, and digital piracy in real time. We are a young and diverse team based in Germany aiming to facilitate access and insight for everyone who needs to understand and comply with regulations in the automotive industry. Addressing the product integrity needs using a novel holistic approach, will allow automotive companies to focus on innovation and production.

name: Colibri
description: ColibrITD is developing a framework aimed at making Quantum Computing technology accessible to any enterprise, in order to be able to take advantage of the second Quantum revolutions.

name: conjectAG
description:
Conject AG was a German technology company specializing in digital solutions for the construction industry. Founded in 2000, Conject provided cloud-based software solutions to improve project management, construction processes, and collaboration within the built environment.

In 2016, Conject AG was acquired by Aconex, an Australian-based company known for its cloud-based construction management platform.

name: ConxAI
description:
CONXAI is building an AI platform for the AEC industry to quickly and easily contextualize different types & formats of project lifecycle data from multiple sources, and transform them into actionable knowledge.

We aim to effortlessly equip the AEC teams with the data and knowledge they need to deliver higher performance through automateddecision support, planning and workflows.
CONXAI is building its core technology that can tackle multiple AEC-focussed use cases with multiple different data types from a wide variety of sources.

name: CrossEngage
description:
CrossEngage helps companies build long-lasting, valuable customer relationships, through offering and delivering user-friendly software to make marketing communications with target audience is hassle-free, always relevant and hyper personalised.

In 2022, Tealium acquired CrossEngage to expand its offerings in the CDP space and enhance its ability to help businesses deliver personalized customer experiences through more robust data management and orchestration. Today, CrossEngage is known as Spotler DACH.

name: CrossLend GmbH (The Thing GMBH)
description:
CrossLend is a digital debt marketplace with a mission to make the European lending and investment ecosystem more efficient, transparent and profitable.

By means of an innovative securitisation solution, we seamlessly connect originator supply with institutional investor demand, creating uniquely flexible, beneficial opportunities for both. With lenders empowered to lend more and investors able to deploy their capital more efficiently, liquidity is available to flow where it is needed, helping fund Europe’s real economy: a win-win-win situation for all.

name: Ctrl
description:
Ctrl is a customer workspace for revenue teams that helps eliminate all manual work involved in sales processes. Our platform provides a simple interface that seamlessly integrates with work apps and can be easily customized, enabling users to complete and automate an entire workflow in seconds.

With Ctrl, customer-facing teams can easily adopt playbooks, update data and share information with their colleagues, providing full visibility into the sales pipeline.

Join us and empower your Revenue team with the tools they need to work smarter, not harder.

name: dcs travel technologies
description: DCS Travel Technologies is a prominent technology solutions provider specializing in the travel and tourism industry. Founded with the aim of enhancing the efficiency and performance of travel companies, DCS offers a suite of software and platform solutions designed to streamline various aspects of travel management. These solutions cater to a wide range of players in the industry, including tour operators, travel agencies, airlines, hotels, and transportation companies.

name: Deed
description: Deed is the workplace giving platform your people will love. We help Fortune 500 enterprises and fast-growing mid-market companies provide employees with an exciting experience around volunteering, giving, and everyday actions which make the world a better place. We meets today’s employees where they are while helping companies establish an inclusive and purpose-driven culture. Join us as we transform ESG from "Me" to "We"!

name: DeepCode
description: DeepCode was an AI-powered code review platform that provided intelligent, automated code analysis to help developers find bugs, security vulnerabilities, and code quality issues. In 2020, DeepCode was acquired by Snyk, a cybersecurity company specializing in developer-first security solutions.

name: dooyoo.de AG
description:
Dooyoo.de AG was a German-based consumer review platform that allowed users to write and read reviews about a wide range of products and services. Launched in the early 2000s, Dooyoo focused on creating a community-driven platform where users could share their experiences and opinions to help others make informed purchasing decisions.

In 2014, Dooyoo was acquired by Ciao (which itself was owned by Microsoft at the time). Ciao was a similar online review platform, and the acquisition allowed the combined entity to strengthen its presence in the European market. In later years, Ciao itself was absorbed into Microsoft's broader business, and the platform essentially ceased operations.

name: Draftwise
description: DraftWise provides an AI-powered contract and negotiation platform that assists law firms in procuring quality contracts. The company's platform provides lawyers with data-driven intelligence that improves the contract workflow, from first draft to client win.

name: Earlybird Venture Capital
description: Founded in 1997, Earlybird invests in all development and growth phases of technology companies. Among the most experienced venture investors in Europe, Earlybird offers its portfolio companies not only financial resources but also strategic support plus access to an international network and capital markets. With EUR 2 billion under management, eight IPOs, and 30 trade sales, Earlybird is one of the most established and active venture capital firms in Europe.

name: Edyoucated
description: edyoucated is a corporate learning platform providing AI-based personalization of learning paths for the workforce. edyoucated's mission is to empower people to build the skills of their future by structuring the world's skills and content so that learners always receive the right learning material based on their prior knowledge, goals, and learning preferences.

name: element 5 AG
description:
Element 5 AG was a German-based company that specialized in digital distribution and e-commerce solutions for software and digital goods. Founded in 2000, the company focused on providing a platform for vendors to sell software products and licenses through online channels, enabling software developers and publishers to reach customers directly.

In 2006, Element 5 AG was acquired by Digital River, a U.S.-based global e-commerce services company. This acquisition allowed Digital River to expand its presence in Europe and enhance its software distribution capabilities.

name: eleQtron
description: eleQtron is engaged in the construction and commissioning of breakthrough quantum computers with trapped ions. It is a spinoff of the Chair of Quantum Optics at the University of Siegen. eleQtron has successfully implemented new methods for quantum information processing which eliminate the need for laser light for coherent control of quantum logic operations. Instead, qubits are controlled by radio frequency waves in novel ion processors using our proprietary MAGIC technology (Magnetic Gradient Induced Coupling). These processors enable individual control of qubits with the highest precision as well as of their interaction, and show a clear path towards massive scaling.

name: Ethon AI
description: EthonAI is an AI-powered platform that helps manufacturers boost performance by detecting, monitoring, and preventing quality losses at scale. By aggregating process and quality data into a single platform, manufacturers can use EthonAI’s advanced AI methods to analyze and improve the quality of their products and processes. The platform offers a suite of no-code software tools for vision-based defect detection, process monitoring, and root cause analysis. Using EthonAI, manufacturers have seen significant increases in productivity and over 50% reduction in quality losses.

name: Everoad by sennder
description:
Based out of Berlin, sennder was founded in 2015 by David Nothacker, Nicolaus Schefenacker, and Julius Koehler. In 2020, Everoad, the French leader in digital freight forwarding based in Paris and founded by Maxime Legardez, merged with sennder to become Europe's leading digital freight forwarder. By merging with sennder, Everoad becomes "Everoad by sennder."

Our mission as a data-based technology company is to revolutionize the logistics and transport industry by connecting small freight companies with large business groups. By introducing technology, we remove the challenges and inefficienc

name: eyva
description: eyva connects market, product, and consumer data, enabling you to use AI to identify gaps in your existing portfolio, optimize current products, and eliminate underperforming ones.

name: finmid
description: finmid is a platform enabling software businesses to grow their revenue by embedding financial services in their product through a single integration. By productizing the complexity of financial services, finmid empowers companies to offer financial services where FinTech isn't the mission, but enables the mission.

name: fintechOS
description: FintechOS provides a rapid application development platform for financial institutions which allows them to build end-to-end digital applications faster compared to traditional IT approaches while decreasing labour costs.

name: FiteTV
description: FITE is the leading independent digital distributor of combat sports. For the enthusiast, the FITE app turns your phone into a universal streaming stick compatible with every Wi-Fi connected TV in the world. Fans of combat sports enjoy curated MMA, premium boxing and wrestling video content at a single destination. For promoters it is a direct distribution and marketing channel with global reach and a relevant audience.

name: Flanks
description:
Flanks is a wealth management solution provider that is redefining how the industry works, by making holistic wealth management simple and seamless through a combination of leading edge technology and wealth management expertise. 

The company helps global financial institutions, including banks, family offices, and portfolio trackers, eliminate manual tasks and optimize operations. 

Founded in 2019 in Barcelona by Joaquim de la Cruz, Sergi Lao and Álvaro Morales, former Global Head of Santander Private Banking, Flanks brings together technology innovators and seasoned financial experts to transform complex wealth data into actionable insights

name: Freeverse
description: Freeverse.io is a platform for creating Living Assets: next generation NFTs which can evolve and change based on how they are used; as a result, their market value is controlled by their utility, as opposed to speculation over their rarity. Freeverse’s mission is to bring true ownership of 'living' NFTs into the mainstream, where users truly own their assets, yet companies and content creators retain the right to control how those assets are used within their applications.

name: Gemma Biotherapeutics
description: GEMMABio, a new therapeutics company developing AAV based therapies, with a platform of new AAV serotypes, with a clinical pipeline focusing on pediatric monogenic diseases, and with a large preclinical pipeline for other large impact diseases.

name: Getsafe
description: The insurtech startup from Heidelberg is using technology and AI to help people identify, organize and protect what they care most about in life: With a few clicks, customers can learn about, buy, and manage insurance on their smartphone - simple, transparent, and fair. Together with renowned partners such as Munich Re and leading venture capital investors, Getsafe is bringing the concept of multi-line insurance into the digital age.

name: Goodlegal
description: Goodlegal is a one stop shop for legal compliance which aims to democratize legal by providing individuals and organizations with a legal infrastructure platform to drive standardization and a frictionless engagement with the internal and external stakeholders

name: Greenlyte
description:
We have developed a break-through direct air capture technology that turns ambient air into green hydro-carbons to free the world from fossil fuels. By eliminating CO2 from the atmosphere, we contribute to avoiding the climate crisis. 
The process consists of 3 main process steps. Absorption in liquid sorbent solution, precipitation as hydrogen carbonate and desorption by either alkali water electrolysis, in which case hydrogen is produced as by-product, or via thermal, low calorific waste heat.
Based on 15 years of research GCT was founded as a university spin-out by 2 serial entrepreneurs and an experienced DAC researcher. The company is based in Essen – in the heart of industrial Germany – surrounded by leading technical universities and global chemical, industrial and energy companies.

name: Greenlyte Carbon Technologies
description: GCT operates a low energy DAC approach to capture CO2 while generating hydrogen as a byproduct. The process consists of three main process steps: absorption in a liquid, precipitation, and desorption through alkaline electrolysis. The technology is based on 15 years of research, with relevant patent applications filed and working prototypes. The company was founded as a university spin-out by two serial entrepreneurs and an experienced DAC researcher.

name: Greywolf Therapeutics
description: Greywolf Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech company advancing novel antigen modulation technology which enhances the activation of T-cells and thereby guides the immune response. Greywolf’s technology modulates antigen presentation, flicking a switch inside cells to alter their appearance to the immune system. Their mission is to deliver new treatments to improve the lives of people with cancer, autoimmune disorders, and infectious diseases.

name: Hakuna
description:
Hakuna is a technology company in the insurance space founded in 2021 by serial entrepreneurs Sebastian Jost, Orhan Köroglu and Rupert Mayer. Hakuna provides embedded insurance solutions for eCommerce platforms as well as Retailers with the goal to enable merchants of any size and industry to offer an AppleCare-like user experience.

The insurtech with offices in Munich and Berlin provides the complete infrastructure European-wide, with an API-first approach that delivers tailored product protection plans such as warranty extensions that perfectly blend into the merchant’s value proposition. 

Hakuna is backed by well-known VC firms such as Earlybird, Visionaries Club and Discovery Ventures, and top tier business angels including Victor Jacobsson (Founder Klarna) and Marc Christ (Founder SumUp).

name: Haya Therapeutics
description: HAYA Therapeutics is a precision medicines company developing programmable therapeutics that target regulatory RNAs derived from the dark genome – a cell information processing unit. The goal is to reprogram pathological cell states for the treatment of rare, common, chronic and aging-related diseases, including cardiovascular disease and cancer.

name: Hilo
description: Hilo is on a mission to manage the world’s blood pressure. By integrating advanced AI algorithms with extensive datasets, Hilo’s cuffless blood pressure monitoring (CBPM) products offer convenient, valuable reports to give both individuals and healthcare professionals a useful picture of their blood pressure. With the foundation model for blood pressure trained on billions of optical signals and hundreds of millions of readings across more than 120,000 users, Hilo is a leader in the CPBM category.

name: Hive
description:
Hive stores and ships products for small and medium-sized online merchants the next day. The company's multichannel integrations, D2C and B2B orders, custom packaging, and smooth return handling will help to optimize the operations. It integrates with over fifteen delivery carriers, and inventory is automatically distributed between five fulfillment centers to save money and time.

Hive was founded in 2020 and is based in Berlin, Germany.

name: Hive Technologies
description:
Hive Technologies is a Berlin-based start-up set to revolutionise D2C operations. By providing relevant solutions, Hive addresses customer satisfaction and creates real added value along the entire supply chain. Hive focuses primarily on the fast-growing D2C market. 

Hive relies on an integrative solution with operations and software plus an outstanding team with experience from large logistics companies, e-commerce players like Zalando, tech start-ups as well as strategic consultancies. Starting from fulfillment, Hive builds full-suite operations software for the entire value-chain. 

The merchant app enables real-time sync of inventory and order data, and enriches information for store owners with valuable logistics insights. The product will grow to feature smart insights and suggestions for optimization to evolve into the operations cockpit for D2C brands. Additional software integrations will allow handling of more complex parts of the supply chain such as procurement or delivery.

name: HiveMQ
description: HiveMQ is the Industrial AI Platform helping enterprises move from connected devices to intelligent operations. Built on the MQTT standard and a distributed edge-to-cloud architecture, HiveMQ connects and governs industrial data in real time, enabling organizations to act with intelligence. With proven reliability, scalability, and interoperability, HiveMQ provides the foundation industrial companies need to operationalize AI, powering the next generation of intelligent industry. Global leaders, including Audi, BMW, Eli Lilly, Liberty Global, Mercedes-Benz, and Siemens, trust HiveMQ to run their most mission-critical operations.

ImCheck Therapeutics is designing and developing a new generation of immunotherapeutic antibodies targeting butyrophilins, a novel super-family of immunomodulators.
As demonstrated by lead clinical-stage program ICT01, which has a mechanism of action to simultaneously modulate innate and adaptive immunity, ImCheck’s “first-in-class” activating antibodies may be able to produce superior clinical results as compared to the first-generation of immune checkpoint inhibitors and, when used in combination, to overcome resistance to this group of agents.

name: Inkitt
description: Inkitt is building the Disney of the 21st Century, standing at the forefront of technology and entertainment. Leveraging AI and predictive algorithms, Inkitt discovers unknown stories and turns them into blockbuster hits, producing a new $1M ebook every 4 weeks and selling directly to consumers through its Galatea app. Inkitt has become the 11th most bestseller-generating publisher in the world, boasting a 40x higher hit-rate than traditional publishers. Recently raising a Series C and backed by some of the top VCs such as Khosla, Kleiner Perkins, and NEA Ventures, our recent expansion into Ca

name: Inkitt GmbH
description: Inkitt is the world’s first data-driven book publisher and has developed an algorithm that can predict bestsellers. Inkitt’s digital library currently holds more than 80,000 stories spanning all genres: romance, fantasy, sci-fi, mystery, thriller and more. Inkitt’s mission is to democratize publishing by putting the power in the audience’s hands: “If readers love it, we publish it.” The company’s algorithm analyses over 1,200 reading behavior dimensions to identify patterns and understand which novels have a strong potential to become future bestsellers. Once a novel is picked up by the algorithm, Inkitt publishes it and also supports the author with cover design and editing services as well as a dedicated marketing team to promote the book.

name: Interhyp
description: Interhyp AG, headquartered in Munich, Germany, is one of the country’s leading independent mortgage brokers. Founded in 1999, the company offers tailored mortgage solutions to private clients through its extensive network of partner banks and financial institutions. With a focus on customer-centric advice and a wide range of financing options, Interhyp has become a trusted partner for individuals seeking to finance their home ownership, whether for buying a new property or refinancing an existing loan. Interhyp operates both online and through regional offices, providing expertise in mortgage products, interest rate management, and financial planning.

name: Involve Space
description: Involve Space provides solutions for space-based activities via a customizable and cost-effective stratospheric pseudo satellite.

name: Isar Aerospace
description: Isar Aerospace democratizes access to space through flexible and low-cost satellite launch services. The company capitalizes on technology leaps in advanced manufacturing increasing both performance and environmental responsibility. Based on cutting-edge rocket engineering research, the innovative propulsion architecture lowers emissions drastically for sustainable use of space, paving the way for future space exploration.

name: iSTAR Medical
description: iSTAR Medical is a clinical-stage, medical technology company focused on the development of novel ophthalmic implants for patients with glaucoma, the second leading cause of adult blindness globally. iSTAR Medical has exclusive rights to the STAR® material from the University of Washington in Seattle (USA) for ophthalmic use. The porous material exhibits outstanding anti-fibrotic and anti-inflammatory properties providing the foundation for the development of MINIjectTM, designed to be a best-in-class micro-invasive glaucoma surgery (MIGS) device. MIGS is the most promising and fastest-growing therapeutic option for the treatment of glaucoma, the fast-growing MIGS market being expected to reach $2.0bn worldwide by 2028.

name: Junto Education GmbH
description:
Junto is a digital-first upskilling platform.

Today's relevant business know-how is no longer taught at yesterday's universities. It is locked in the minds of a small circle of leading global tech operators and their high-growth organizations.

For ambitious startups & their talents Junto unlocks this know-how through interactive live courses powered by world-class tech operators, e.g. with experience from Google, Amazon, Adobe, Gorillas, or N26.

On top of this unique operator network, Junto builds a life-long learning community & technology platform that enables fast growing companies to accelerate their execution and attract & retain the best talent.

name: Keel
description:
Keel is a London-based startup offering modern businesses a much-needed third choice between off-the-shelf and no-code tools. Keel has developed a powerful programmable operations platform which offers all the benefits of bespoke tooling without the need to build from scratch.
Keel was founded in 2022 by Benoit Machefer, Tom Frew and Jon Bretman, who directly experienced the frustration of being underserved by off-the-shelf software when scaling the fastest growing online pharmacy in Europe to over $130m revenue. The company represents a compelling vision of a future without legacy ERP, where ops teams and engineers work more closely together building operations systems on the robust and secure Keel platform. 
Keel is backed by well-known European investors Earlybird and LocalGlobe.

name: Kiwilogic.com AG

This acquisition allowed NFON to expand its product offerings and enhance its capabilities in providing unified communication and collaboration services.

 nsights, and integrate those insights into operational systems.

name: Lexoo Ltd.
description:
Lexoo is creating the law firm of the future. Lexoo’s clients are in-house lawyers at the world's most innovative companies. Lexoo enables them to rapidly hire teams of lawyers in over 70 countries through Lexoo's data driven platform. 

Lexoo's lawyers are typically former 'big law' lawyers who are now working more efficiently. Clients save roughly 50% without sacrificing quality.

name: Liquid M, Inc.
description: One DSP to rule them all. A single intuitive platform – multiple powerful tools & features. Straight-to-the-point and efficient campaign management for effective programmatic advertising.

name: M0
description: M0 is the universal platform powering builders of application‑specific stablecoins. With M0, developers can build safe, programmable, and interoperable digital dollars.

name: Marvel Fusion
description: Marvel Fusion, founded in Munich in 2019, pursues a new and fast-track route to the commercial application of fusion energy to provide zero-emissions unlimited energy to the global markets. Marvel Fusion’s new technology concept is based on highly intense short-pulsed lasers and proprietary fuel targets. Scientists from the Ludwig-Maximilians-University in Munich, the University of Stanford and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) have recently joined forces with Marvel Fusion to bring its fusion concept to fruition. In its next steps, Marvel Fusion will upgrade existing laser systems (2022-2025) to validate its novel technology and to demonstrate the path to net energy gain.

name: Matchory
description: We are removing the barriers of complex supplier sourcing by increasing transparency to create more room for innovation. To do this, we have developed a solution that empowers buyers and ultimately consumers to make more sustainable choices: We collect relevant information along the supply chain and make it centrally available to strategic sourcing.

name: Matchory.com
description: Matchory is a cloud-based supplier search engine. Matchory collects and processes global supplier data and compiles it into a unique supplier database. It uses mostly public data, including website information, certifications, sustainability information, company KPIs, customer relationships, and more. Matchory software helps strategic buyers and tech scouts in their daily sourcing business to make more efficient and reliable decisions. Relevant suppliers from all industries can be identified in real time, backed by state-of-the-art technology such as Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learnin

name: minit
description: Minit is a provider of automated business process discovery and mining software (“process mining”) used to visualize and analyze the business processes of an organization based on actual data obtained from the enterprise software applications.

name: Mona AI
description: MONA AI is an automation software designed for the human resources services sector, aimed at streamlining HR processes and improving efficiency through artificial intelligence-driven solutions

name: Mostly AI
description: Mostly AI solves one of the biggest challenges organizations are facing today: balancing their need for Big Data & AI innovation with GDPR/CCPA compliance and privacy protection. By generating Synthetic Data, Mostly AI helps organizations to unlock their privacy-sensitive Big Data assets, as their fundamentally new approach to big data anonymization retains all of the valuable information in a dataset, while protecting the privacy of every data subject. This results in completely anonymous data, that is free to use, free to share and free to monetize.

name: Myriad AG
description: We provide integrated, secure platforms and open APIs to support our partner Financial Institutions, Mobile Money Operators, and Payment Solutions clients in creating innovative digital financial services.

name: N26
description:
N26 is Europe’s leading digital bank with a full German banking license. It offers simple, secure and customer-friendly mobile banking to millions of customers in 24 markets across Europe. 

N26 processes over 140bn EUR in transactions a year and currently has a 1,500-strong team of more than 90 nationalities. The company is headquartered in Berlin, with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna, Paris, Milan and Barcelona. 

Founded by Valentin Stalf and Maximilian Tayenthal in 2013, N26 has raised close to US$ 1.8 billion from some of the world’s most renowned investors.

name: NcodiN
description: NcodiN develops nanophotonic chips for data transport for processors that improves speed, energy efficiency and heating of the circuit.

name: Neotaste
description: NeoTaste is a mobile app that empowers users to explore restaurants and cafés in their city, enticed by exclusive deals available at these locations. We have managed to digitally bring together gastronomy and guests, which results in new advantages for both sides. Through NeoTaste, restaurants can showcase attractive deals, optimizing their capacity utilization and attracting fresh clientele. Acting as a free marketing platform, NeoTaste opens doors for restaurateurs to expand their customer base and enhance their digital presence.

name: Neuracore
description: Neuracore is an all-in-one platform for robotics, enabling teams to capture asynchronous data, train vision-action-language models, and deploy robots at scale. Designed for the data-driven era of robotics, Neuracore helps companies bring smarter, more capable robots to market faster than the competition.

name: NFON
description: NFON is a Munich, Germany-based provider of outsourced telephone systems. NFON's outsourced telephone systems, called IP Centrex, are offered as a complete package from a single source. Operated by a fully redundant, high-performance computer centre and with more than 100 functions, the solution is designed to enable companies of all sizes to save up to 50% of the costs for a conventional phone system.

name: NFON AG
description:
NFON AG is a leading European provider of cloud-based communication solutions for businesses. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, NFON specializes in delivering scalable and flexible cloud telephony and unified communications (UC) services.

NFON's platform enables businesses of all sizes to streamline communication processes by offering advanced voice services, video conferencing, and collaboration tools, all hosted in the cloud. Their solutions are designed to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance the overall customer experience, providing businesses with the freedom to communicate seamlessly from anywhere, at any time.

name: Nortech
description: Nortech delivers a complete end-to-end IoT solution for the maritime industry, offering data extraction and customizable KPI visualization.

name: Nosh Biofoods
description: Nosh Biofoods is a developer of traditional meat. It produces technical-functional components and nutritional protein by utilizing manufacturing technologies to explore natural microbial biodiversity.

name: Nosh.bio
description:
Nosh.bio, is a Berlin based startup focused on developing the next generation of highly functional food ingredients, from clean label, non-GMO, microbes.
Positioned as B2B Partner, Nosh helps animal-free foods to achieve the breakthrough and appeal the mass market to create a food system that is no longer harmfull to the planet, animals or people.
Founded in 2022 by Tim Fronzek, a german entrepreneur, and Felipe Lino, a brazilian bioscientist, the company already represents 8 different nationalities and will launch its first products within the next 12 months.

name: Obligate
description: Obligate allows companies to issue on-chain bonds and commercial paper to receive funding from investors in a regulated DeFi environment. The company utilizes smart contracts and tokenization in place of intermediaries such as paying and issuer agents to be able to reduce the costs associated with a bond issuance by 80% and reduce the time needed for an issuance from weeks to hours. Obligat was founded in 2019 and is located in Zurich, Switzerland.

name: Obligate (ex FQX)
description: FQX is radically facilitating trade finance & money markets by using eNotes™, a disruptive short-term financing & payment instrument. An eNote™ is an unconditional promise to pay a specific sum to another party at a specific future date. The eNote™ is based on Blockchain technology and can be flexibly sold and transferred to any third party (i.e. an investor). When compared to other financing options, eNotes™ as negotiable instruments outperform through their financial steering capabilities and global transferability.

name: Oculis
description: Oculis focuses on ophthalmic drugs and topical eye drug formulations. Oculis has developed a formulation technology consisting of a novel technique to facilitate drug absorption to both anterior and posterior parts of the eye. The advantage is a drug formulation where diseases of the posterior part of the eye can be treated with a simple topical application (i.e., eye drops) instead of injections or implants.

name: OneFootball
description:
Reaching more than 70 million football fans worldwide every month across its platform and social media channels, OneFootball is the most popular football media platform for the new generation of football fans. It’s the only app with a fully personalised homestream for non-stop news on your favourite club, and the only company to offer single live football matches in-app on a pay-per-view basis.

In the spirit that football is more than just 90 minutes, OneFootball operates a 24-hour newsroom to provide fans across the world with the comprehensive football content they crave – from statistics and live scores of 200+ leagues and competitions worldwide to breaking news, highlight clips, live streaming, transfer rumours and features. Native integration from OneFootball’s network of hundreds of independent content creators, clubs, federations, players and broadcasters adds an additional 13,000+ pieces of content per week.

OneFootball is available in 12 languages and is the best-rated sports app in the world, based on millions of App Store and Google Play reviews. Founded twelve years ago, the company has 220 employees at its headquarters in Berlin and regional offices in London, New York, Mexico City and São Paulo."

name: OneShield
description:
OneShield’s cloud-based and SaaS platforms include enterprise-level policy management, billing, claims, rating, relationship management, product configuration, business intelligence, and smart analytics. Designed specifically for personal, commercial, and specialty insurance, our solutions support over 90 lines of business.

OneShield’s clients, some of the world’s leading insurers, benefit from optimized workflows, pre-built content, seamless upgrades, collaborative implementations, and pricing models designed to lower the total cost of ownership. Our global footprint includes corporate headquarters in Marlborough, MA, with additional offices throughout India.

name: ORis
description: ORiS is a Turin-based deep-tech startup developing laser-based wireless power transmission systems for space and dual-use applications. The company is building an in-orbit energy distribution grid to give satellites access to additional energy directly in orbit, helping operators extend mission lifetime, operate through eclipse periods and design more ambitious missions. Founded at Politecnico di Torino, ORiS combines expertise in high-power lasers, pointing systems, detection and tracking, and thermal control.

name: Ottonova
description: Founded in 2017, ottonova has been reinventing the way customers interact with their health insurance by building a completely new technology platform with a user-friendly front-end mobile application. Simple processes, transparency, and a wide range of digital services are fundamental for ensuring maximum satisfaction among customers in all matters relating to their insurance and health – while also saving as much time as possible.

name: Oviva
description: Oviva is a digital health company that helps people with conditions such as obesity and diabetes improve their health with medical nutritional therapy delivered by technology. Clients can log meals with photos, record activity and weight with trackers, and ask questions. A therapist provides personalized support and advice to help people achieve their goals. Oviva's goal is to improve access and outcomes to better treatment at lower costs.

name: PARIMA
description:
PARIMA is a global leader in protein innovation. The company develops high-quality cultivated foods directly from animal cells to meet rising global demand for nutritious protein with greater efficiency and lower resource use. 

Formed through the combination of Gourmey and Vital Meat, PARIMA brings together advanced expertise in cell cultivation, bioprocessing, and culinary development to build a more efficient global protein supply.

In October 2025, PARIMA became the first European company granted regulatory approval for cultivated protein. Its culinary brand, Gourmey, focuses on premium cultivated meats co-developed with Michelin-starred chefs worldwide.

name: Peak Games
description: Peak Games has successfully built a global user base for its community-based, multiplayer board and card games as well as its innovative casual puzzle games. The company has quickly moved from being a dominant regional leader with culturally relevant titles to a global player, serving cross-platform games with mass appeal. Over 275 million users around the world have installed at least one of the company’s products. Peak Games is funded by Earlybird Venture Capital, Hummingbird Ventures and Endeavor Catalyst.

name: peopleIX
description:
peopleIX is an AI-powered people intelligence platform that enables organizations to consolidate, analyze, and act on critical workforce data. By delivering intuitive, no-code analytics, peopleIX helps businesses enhance productivity, retention, and hiring.

peopleIX addresses the challenges HR leaders face with fragmented data spread across multiple tools—HR Information Systems (HRIS), Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), performance & engagement tools, payroll, and business systems. The platform integrates data across HR systems into a single source of truth, delivering real-time insights without requiring data science expertise and is trusted by industry leaders like d.velop, rebuy, Koro, simplicity, and OMR.

Founded in 2022 by Nick Stodt and Dr. Georg Schaal, peopleIX announced the successful closure of its €2.3 million pre-seed funding round led by Earlybird-X in March 2025.

name: Perfuze
description: Perfuze is developing innovative catheter technology to treat acute ischemic stroke. The technology is intended to provide superior clinical outcomes in shorter procedural times; resulting in safe, cost-effective therapy.

name: Photoneo
description: Photoneo is a provider of complete 3D computer vision technology which empowers industrial automation systems with advanced object recognition and manipulation capabilities.

name: Pillar
description:
Pillar builds the operating system for construction - the world's largest industry and one of the least digitized - integrating invoicing, cash flow, bank reconciliation, and site management in one platform, with AI that automates the back office in real time.

Data flows seamlessly from accounting systems, bank feeds, and directly from sites via WhatsApp in natural language, requiring no change to existing workflows. The result is a simple, powerful interface that gives construction operators full visibility over their construction site management and the foundation from which Pillar is building a comprehensive ecosystem for the entire industry.

name: Pointee
description: Pointee provides a platform to monitor, analyze, manage and optimize the performance of Robotic Process Automation (RPA) deployments employed at scale in mid to large-size enterprises.

name: Polares Medical
description: Polares is revolutionizing the mitral regurgitation (MR) market with an innovative endoluminal implanted augmentation device. Unlike current endoluminal transcatheter mitral valve therapies that mechanically clip leaflets together, which restricts future interventions to total valve replacement, Polares' approach potentially treats and preserves options for future mitral valve therapies across the diverse MR patient population

name: Portal Biotech
description: Portal Biotech is a life science tools company focusing on cost-effective and accessible full-length protein sequencing using proprietary nanopore technology and AI/ML algorithms.

name: Porters
description: Derived from the Latin portare, “to carry”, the name Porters represents the company’s mission to help customers move, support, and manage their operational loads. Porters is building the autonomous backoffice for banks and fintechs, driven by a bold vision of running banking operations end-to-end through AI. The company combines cutting-edge AI technology with deep operational banking expertise to automate mission-critical processes, redefining how financial institutions solve complex operational tasks in the AI era.

name: PrioThera
description: PrioThera is a ph3 clinical stage pharma company developing a non-immunosuppressive molecule for the treatment of high-risk acute myeloid leukaemia.  Mocravimod has been extensively tested in multiple immunological models and has shown a survival benefit and reduced severity of  graft-versus-host disease in earlier clinical studies.

name: Prothea Technologies
description: Prothea Technologies’ vision is to offer lung cancer biopsy and treatment in a single hospital visit. Lung cancer is the third most common form of cancer in the U.S. and annually claims more lives than breast, prostate and colon cancer combined. Prothea is developing a medical device consisting of a Microendoscope combined with an Image Processing System, which enhances visualisation by providing in situ analysis of lesion structure at a molecular level. Further R&D is planned to develop a laser ablation catheter for the treatment of lesions immediately following visualisation and biopsy. The integration of these two systems (real-time imaging and ablation) will streamline biopsy and treatment into a single hospital visit, reducing time-to-treat from weeks to minutes, thereby relieving hospital pressures and improving patient outcomes.

name: QuantumDiamonds
description: QuantumDiamonds GmbH is the global leader in semiconductor equipment based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich, the company has developed Quantum Diamond Microscopy (QDM), a breakthrough technology that uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to visualize electrical activity inside advanced chips without cutting, delayering, or destroying the device. Its patented systems allow semiconductor manufacturers to detect hidden defects, improve yields, and accelerate development cycles for next-generation packaging technologies. QuantumDiamonds was founded in 2022 and is based in Munich, Germany.

name: RapidMiner
description: RapidMiner builds software for real data science, fast and simple. It makes data science teams more productive by offering a single platform that unifies data prep, machine learning and model deployment. More than 200,000 users in over 150 countries use RapidMiner products to acquire more customers, reduce financial risk and increase operational performance.

name: Recursive
description: Recursive is an AI company based in London and San Francisco, building self-improving systems designed to automate knowledge discovery. By developing open-ended algorithms that allow AI to recursively improve itself, the company aims to push the frontier of AI research and create a foundation that could eventually reshape scientific progress across disciplines.

name: Remberg
description: The Remberg Asset Platform is where industrial workers, AI copilots, and agents collaborate across organizations over the entire lifecycle of assets.

name: remberg GmbH
description: remberg is a Munich-based start-up, building a new breed of CRM-software for companies to digitize processes around their equipment such as machines, buildings and vehicles - the basis for the age of the internet of things (IoT).

name: Riiico
description: At RIIICO, we are collaborating closely with industry-leading companies, supporting their ambitions to leverage the power of 3D intelligence. These co-creational efforts with global leaders have driven our growing team to continuously break new ground – building products that solve problems.

name: Ripe
description: Founded by Elin Lütz and Jonatan Dykert in 2021, Ripe is a Sweden-based company that has developed a product-led sales platform helping B2B companies to reveal and engage with their most relevant users and customers. The platform enables revenue teams to couple product and CRM data to uncover and engage with prioritized sales opportunities.

name: Rivia
description: Rivia is a Zurich-based technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today’s capital. Over the past two years,   European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In the years ahead, the company will scale its platform and embedded intelligence to help bring groundbreaking therapies to market faster.

name: Scoreloop AG
description: Scoreloop, a subsidiary of BlackBerry, was a cross-platform social gaming network for the operating systems including BlackBerry (Tablet OS and BlackBerry 10), Android, Bada, iOS and Windows Phone 7

name: Sennder
description: sennder is Europe’s leading freight forwarder offering shippers access to their connected fleet of thousands of trucks. In a traditional industry, sennder is fast-forwarding road logistics, focusing on the digitalization and automation of all road logistics processes. By leveraging proprietary technology, sennder is building an ecosystem that leads the industry into the 21st century with a new degree of transparency, efficiency and flexibility.

name: Service Partner One GmbH
description: Service Partner ONE provides the first digital integrated facility service cloud for facility services and related procurement. The cloud service connects via its web-based applications commercial clients and service providers to enable a fully digitized process from customer acquisition, via order processing and execution to invoicing. Combining the best of CRM, ERP, DMS, CAFM in a user-friendly and simple designed interface, the first facility service cloud – “SP ONE”. While clients can easily procure, manage and expense facility services via one single point, service providers get access to the first digital integrated service cloud to sell, operate and administer. Service Partner ONE is on its way to become the go-to-destination for commercial clients and service providers in the facility service market.

name: Sessions
description: Sessions (formerly known as Flow OS) is an application for organizations that provides communication features (voice, video, chat) as well as native integrations to different third-party collaboration and productivity applications. Sessions is being developed on top of Flow OS framework, a proprietary integrative software concept for bundling communication and collaboration functions.

name: Shape Memory Medical
description: Shape Memory Medical is a global medical devices company focused on innovative therapeutic embolization solutions for peripheral vascular, cardiovascular, and neurovascular markets using shape memory polymer technology. Shape is the only company using the science of smart polymer to address challenging medical conditions. The polymer technology was originally developed at Texas A&M University and Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory.

name: ShapeShift
description:
Since 2014, ShapeShift has been pioneering self-custody for digital asset trading. The company’s web and mobile platforms allow users worldwide to safely buy, hold, trade, and interact with digital assets such as Bitcoin and Ethereum.

ShapeShift allows users to buy crypto with fiat, trade, track, and secure their crypto through a simple web interface.

name: Sikoia
description: Sikoia helps Fintechs, lenders and corporates not only navigate but capitalise on the latest financial innovations and cut through the noise of an increasingly fragmented Fintech service provider landscape. By unifying third party data and APIs into a single interface while automating workflows and advanced analytics, Sikoia extends the capabilities of existing systems, increases efficiency, and reduces regulatory risk.

name: Simr
description: Simr (formerly known as UberCloud) provides a scalable High Performance Computing platform, powered by a unique software container technology, that enables engineers to run technical computing software in the Cloud.

name: Simscale
description: SimScale is the world’s first cloud-based engineering simulation platform for CFD, FEA and thermal simulation and it is revolutionizing the way engineers and designers create products. The SimScale platform is accessible completely via a standard web browser, with an easy-to-use interface that supports numerous simulation types.

name: Sintra
description: Sintra builds AI employees for small to medium-sized companies to help them with marketing, sales, strategy, recruiting, and everything in between. Perfect for those who can't afford to hire real staff, but still need help. With over 40,000+ customers in 100+ countries, Sintra helps small businesses grow and manage their operations with ease.
founders: Chris Sidlauskas                                                                                                                                                                                               Rokas Judickas                                                                                                                                                                                                Vasaris Kaveckas

name: SLNG
description: SLNG is a global, compliance-first Speech AI gateway that enables developers and enterprises to build Voice AI products with local compute, data residency, and industry-grade compliance. SLNG was founded after recognizing that existing providers still route compute through the US and overlook compliance—creating dealbreakers as regulations tighten. SLNG solves this by standardizing workloads, offering all speech models in one platform, auto-scaling infrastructure in-region, and ensuring no vendor lock-in. With a highly international and growing team, SLNG delivers the open, scalable foundation for global Voice AI deployment.

name: smava
description: smava is an online loan comparison platform. It brings private applicants together with a huge variety of banks and private investors, offering highly attractive interest rates for loans from 1,000€ up to 120,000€. Using smava’s sophisticated scoring technology, customers can receive a tailored online loan with the best conditions free of charge within seconds. Our customers use financing for a large number of plans, such as car financing, property renovation and loan consolidating. Furthermore, customers receive free and independent advice from our highly trained loan consultants. smava’s concept has convinced independent testers for years.

name: Snyk
description: Snyk is a developer-first security company that helps software-driven businesses develop fast and stay secure.

name: Socialbakers
description: Socialbakers is a leading social media marketing platform that helps businesses and marketers optimize their social media performance through data-driven insights, content analysis, and audience engagement tools. Founded in 2008, Socialbakers provides a comprehensive suite of tools for social media analytics, performance tracking, and competitor benchmarking across various platforms like Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, and more.

name: SpAItial
description: SpAItial is a novel artificial intelligence paradigm that can create and reason about the physics and appearance of both imagined and real-world surroundings.

name: spAitial Ai
description:
SpAItial is pioneering Spatial Foundation Models (SFMs), a groundbreaking AI paradigm designed to generate and reason about the appearance and physics of real and imagined environments. SFMs possess an intrinsic understanding of space-time, enabling transformative shifts in applications at the intersection of virtual and physical worlds.

Unlike existing generative AI technologies such as LLMs, image, or video models, SFMs operate natively in physical space. This significantly advances their cognitive capabilities, mimicking human understanding. SFMs promise to revolutionize a vast range of applications across industries, from creating immersive virtual worlds for gaming and entertainment, to advancing CAD engineering and construction, to powering next-generation VR/AR experiences, and enabling sophisticated, physically-intelligent robotics.
founders: Luke Rogers                                                                                                                                                                                                 Matthias Niessner                                                                                                                                                                                            David Novotny                                                                                                                                                                                               Ricardo Martin-Brulla

name: Tasty Urban
description: Tasty Urban is a dynamic food tech company revolutionizing the way people discover, enjoy, and share food. Specializing in food delivery and restaurant services, Tasty Urban connects customers with a diverse range of culinary experiences from local restaurants and eateries. The platform provides a seamless, user-friendly interface that allows customers to order food conveniently, while restaurants can leverage Tasty Urban’s tools to enhance their visibility and operations.

name: Terralayr
description: Terralayr uses software to collect energy grid-scale storage, which will be required as we strive to make renewable energy more efficient and lucrative. The cloud-based software platform provides energy flexibility "as-a-service" to various customer groups, including power producers, grid operators, and large power consumers like data centers. Terralayr develops and manages its own battery storage assets, currently operating one asset, with several under construction and a development pipeline exceeding 5GW in Germany.

name: Terralayr AG
description:
We're a team dedicated to overcoming the hurdles of renewable energy. Our goal is simple: to ensure a continuous and sustainable power supply, regardless of unpredictable demand or fluctuating energy sources. By harnessing the power of battery storage, we're paving the way for a future fueled entirely by renewables.

But we don't do it alone. We collaborate with landowners, battery suppliers, and communities to build a world where 100% renewable energy is a reality. Together, we're driving the transition towards a cleaner, more sustainable energy future.

name: The Interaction Company of California
description: The Interaction Company of California is a Palo Alto-based AI startup building Poke.com

name: ThingsThinking
description: Our artificial intelligence semantha® understands natural language regardless of the choice of words. She is able to read large amounts of text and finds relevant content.

name: TILT
description: TILT is social commerce platform aiming to create an immersive shopping experience for the next generation. On the mobile app, shoppers can jump into video and live stream rooms created by brands, invite friends, or chat with other shoppers. Brands can connect their stores to TILT in seconds, allowing them to create shoppable content by linking their products to rooms. By creating a social shopping experience, TILT aims to solve the boredom inherent in online shopping.

name: Tipp24 AG
description:
Tipp24 AG is a leading provider of online lottery services, offering customers the opportunity to participate in national and international lotteries via the internet. Founded in 1999, Tipp24 revolutionized the lottery industry by enabling online access to major lottery games, including the German Lotto, EuroMillions, and others. The company allows users to purchase lottery tickets, check results, and manage their winnings through an easy-to-use online platform.

In 2013, Tipp24 AG shifted its business focus to a B2B model, providing its services to other businesses within the lottery and gaming sector through its subsidiary, Tipp24 Services. Today, Tipp24 AG operates under the umbrella of the Zeal Network SE, one of the leading players in the global online lottery industry, continuing to innovate in the fields of digital gaming and customer engagement.

name: TopK
description: Built for scale and performance, TopK is a document database with native multi-vector, keyword, and faceted search—all in a single, composable query. It's the starting point for a new class of AI-native search engines, ones that understand your data, eliminate complexity, and raise the bar for relevance in production.

name: ubitricity
description: Ubitricity has developed a highly efficient solution to make charging and billing of green electricity affordable everywhere. The Ubitricity Mobile Charging System offers the first possibility to roll out scalable charging infrastructure everywhere. To this end, Ubitricity has developed an intelligent charging cable which entails all metering and billing technology: the SmartCable. The user carries the mobile electricity contract, tied to the SmartCable, along to the charging spot. The technologically lean charging spots produce next to no running costs. They can be installed practically every

name: Ubitricity GmbH
description:
Ubitricity GmbH is a German-based technology company that focuses on providing smart charging solutions for electric vehicles (EVs). Founded in 2008, Ubitricity specializes in innovative infrastructure and software for sustainable urban mobility, helping to facilitate the transition to cleaner transportation.

In 2020, Ubitricity was acquired by Shell, as part of Shell's broader strategy to expand its electric vehicle charging network and invest in sustainable energy solutions. The acquisition enhanced Ubitricity's ability to scale its technology across more markets globally.

name: UiPath
description: UiPath streamlines processes, uncovers efficiencies and provides insights, making the path to digital transformation fast and cost-effective.  It was founded in Bucharest, Romania and headquarters are now in New York City.

name: Upvest
description: Upvest provides a highly scalable and modular API service that enables fintechs all over Europe to launch investment products easily. Fintechs benefit from programmatic access to the best assets. Asset managers extend their reach all over Europe. The one-stop solution comes with all licenses and is technically crafted for scale and modularity. The product is built proprietarily using blockchain as fast and affordable custody and settlement layer.

name: urbia.com
description: Urbia is a German online platform focused on parenting, family, and lifestyle content. It provides a range of resources for parents, including forums, articles, expert advice, and tools to support families at different stages of life. The site also offers parenting advice, pregnancy guides, and parenting tools such as baby name generators, pregnancy calendars, and forums for parents to connect and share experiences.

name: videdressing
description: Videdressing is a collaborative platform dedicated to the purchase and resale of fashion and luxury items.

name: Wallet Studio
description: Miss Moneypenny Technologies is the company behind Wallet Studio, a leading SaaS platform that leverages the full potential of Apple Wallet and Google Wallet to help businesses create dynamic customer interactions. Trusted by global brands, Wallet Studio enables companies to enhance customer engagement and realize measurable results and cost savings far beyond those of traditional tools.
founders: Anna Bojic                                                                                                                                                                                                                     Marc Lampe                                                                                                                                                                                                          Vinh Hoi Le Chau

name: wellabe
description: wellabe is a preventative health company focused on providing regular checkups for employees to ensure a healthy and productive workforce. The company operates a mobile lab to give employees a convenient way to undergo their health check up. For organisations, wellabe provides the solution to reducing stress, burnout, and increased sick leave from employees.

name: Workist
description:
Workist is a business process automation based on RPA robots called AI Workers that learn through human-AI teamwork. Its B2B transactions are translated, allowing for seamless integration and automated data exchange between business customers, distributors, and suppliers. Using AI, they hope to free up people's time to do more creative and meaningful work. Workist automates the processing of incoming purchase orders so that no one has to manually type in documents again.

Workist was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Berlin, Germany.

name: Workist GmbH
description: Workist is on a mission to eliminate manual document processing in B2B transactions. WorKI, Workist’s AI software, intelligently understands business documents like orders, invoices, and delivery notes and automatically processes all relevant information to perform trade transactions. Our objective is to free people from repetitive work, giving them back the freedom to perform value-adding, meaningful work - one saved keystroke at a time.

name: Xayn AG
description: Xayn is pioneering next genAI for lawyers. We build secure, sovereign, and sustainable AI systems that leverage the power of language models at scale. Trustworthy AI "Made In Germany.
